description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementDecorator class, which adds various helper methods for handling LeaveEntitlement objects, including date formatting, setting related entities, and computing available days within a leave entitlement period.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class providing additional functionalities for LeaveEntitlement entities, such as date formatting, entity association, and entitlement calculations.

methods.name: getAvailableDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of available leave days after subtracting used days from total entitlement.

methods.name: withinPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the entitlement's start and end dates.

methods.name: setEntitlementTypeById
methods.description: Sets the entitlement type of the leave entitlement based on the provided type ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the leave entitlement based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave type for the entitlement using the provided leave type ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted credited date, if available, for the leave entitlement.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Determines if the leave entitlement can be deleted based on business rules.
